title: dryopteris cordata
intro: Dryopteris cordata, commonly known as the cord fern or shuttlecock fern, is a species of fern in the wood fern family, Dryopteridaceae. It is native to North America and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dryopteris cordata include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving respiratory function, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and coumarins, which exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
